sources.reason: The NOAA usnic_ims_snow_ice_1km ImageServer returns rendered symbology, not the documented 0-4 class grid: a 2026-08-30 export gave 117 distinct values in 0-242, and renderingRule={"rasterFunction":"None"} did not change that. Raw classes come from the NSIDC G02156 ASCII archive, which this adapter reads but which needs the polar-stereographic grid files.
